notes.title: v0.0.2 is out.
notes.content:
Hi all,

v0.0.2 of Sandhill Architectures is live. You'll have to restart the Steam client for the download to start. (Also, please let me know if Community posts for every small update are too annoying.)

This update has two changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug (incorrect "CORRECT" output) in the Running Distance Calculator task.
[*]Added auto-indent and "backspace-by-tab-level" in the text editor (Backspace now goes back to the nearest tab).
[/list]

I hope to have an update out soon which adds histograms and some other cool things like syntax highlighting (if I can get it to work).

As always, feel free to post in the Community group or in the [url=https://discord.gg/zETXTy8]Buce Studios Discord[/url] if you have bug reports or feature requests.

-Bryce

notes.title: v0.0.1 is out - Bugfixes and Input Improvements
notes.content:
Hi all,

I just uploaded v0.0.1 of Sandhill Architectures. You'll have to restart the Steam client for the download to start.

The main parts of this update are:
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug where certain solution names would break the game.
    [*]Added support for Home/End/Delete keys in text editor.
    [*]Added support for Irish/Norwegian keyboards (more on this below). [b]You will have to change the layout in the OPTIONS menu.[/b]
[/list]

One limitation which I did not realize was that the text editor only recognized US/English keyboard layouts by default. Unfortunately, the "best" workaround involves coding each layout by hand. This is relatively easy to do, but I will have to add keyboards on a case-by-case basis. I started with Irish and Norwegian, but I'll add more in the very near future.

There are still a handful of good suggestions which I will be implementing soon, but I figured that I'd get this mini-update out quickly.

If you have any bug reports or feature requests, feel free to post in the Community group or in the [url=https://discord.gg/zETXTy8]Buce Studios Discord[/url]. Also, since I don't want to spam Community updates, let me know if this format is too annoying.

-Bryce
